# Nature

> > Nature is a leading international journal publishing peer-reviewed research across all fields of science and technology.

This collection focuses on Nutrition & Diabetes, a specialized journal publishing original research on metabolic disorders, nutritional interventions, and diabetes prevention. The research employs diverse methodologies including cohort studies, meta-analyses, Mendelian randomization, and randomized controlled trials to investigate the complex relationships between diet, metabolism, and chronic disease.

## Key Topics

- Type 2 diabetes (T2D/T2DM)
- Metabolic syndrome
- Insulin resistance
- Prediabetes
- Meta-analysis and systematic reviews
- Mendelian randomization (MR)
- Cohort studies (UK Biobank, NHANES, CHARLS)
- Dietary interventions
- Plant protein and dietary protein
- NAFLD/MASLD (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease)
- Lipid metabolism
- HbA1c and glycemic control
- Diabetes prevention
- 25-hydroxyvitamin D
- Nutritional epidemiology

## Diabetes Risk and Prevention Research

- [Dietary protein and risk of type 2 diabetes: findings from a registry-based cohort study and a meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00380-z): SSACB cohort study on protein intake & T2D risk with meta-analysis
- [The role of circadian rest-activity rhythm for the link between 25-hydroxyvitamin D and type 2 diabetes: a cohort study](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00395-6): UK Biobank study on circadian rhythm, vitamin D & T2D risk mediation
- [Long-term time in target range for body mass index (BMI) and diabetes incidence: insights from CHARLS](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-026-00404-8): CHARLS longitudinal analysis of BMI time-in-range & diabetes incidence
- [The Beverage Quality Index and type 2 diabetes risk in women: a prospective analysis of the Mexican Teachers' Cohort](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-026-00410-4): BQI prospective cohort study on beverage quality & T2D in Mexican women
- [Association between Apolipoprotein B and diabetic nephropathy: insights from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2007–2016 and Mendelian randomization analysis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00370-1): NHANES & MR analysis of ApoB association with diabetic nephropathy risk
- [Density of ectopic fat depots predict distinct biomarkers of glycemic and insulinemic status in persons with HIV](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00381-y): CT-morphometric analysis of ectopic fat & diabetes risk in PWH cohort
- [Association between assisted reproductive technology and gestational diabetes mellitus: the role of serum folate and triglycerides](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-026-00414-0): ART pregnancy cohort examining GDM risk via folate & triglyceride levels

## Metabolic Syndrome and Liver Disease

- [The association between steatotic liver disease and chronic kidney disease: a meta-analysis and Mendelian randomization study highlighting metabolic comorbidities](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-026-00412-2): Meta-analysis & MR study of SLD-CKD link via metabolic comorbidities
- [Ketogenic diet ameliorates MASLD via balancing mitochondrial dynamics and improving mitochondrial dysfunction](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00391-w): KD intervention in MASLD mice improving mitochondrial function via β-OHB
- [Does partial replacement of animal protein with plant protein in the diet affect components of metabolic syndrome, adropin levels, and the atherogenic index of plasma? Results from a parallel randomized clinical trial in adults with metabolic syndrome](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00401-x): RCT comparing plant vs animal protein effects on MetS & adropin levels
- [Interactions among nutrition, metabolism and the immune system in the context of starvation and nutrition-stimulated obesity](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00383-w): Review of nutrient-immune interactions in starvation & obesity via TLRs

## Dietary Interventions and Nutritional Supplements

- [Can high-protein diabetes-specific oral nutritional supplements improve postprandial glycemic response in prediabetes? An open-label, cross-over clinical trial](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00399-2): DSNF-Pro crossover trial on postprandial glucose control in prediabetes
- [Effects of vitamin D supplementation on metabolic factors, serum omentin-1, and anthropometric indices in middle-aged women with prediabetes: a double-blind randomized controlled trial](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00402-w): Vitamin D RCT on insulin resistance & omentin-1 in prediabetic women
- [Investigating the effects of mycoprotein and guar gum on postprandial glucose in type 2 diabetes: a double-blind randomised controlled trial](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00375-w): Double-blind RCT on mycoprotein & guar gum PG effects in T2D patients
- [Impact of jujube fruit on serum lipid profile, glycemic index, and liver function: a systematic review and meta-analysis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00378-7): Systematic review & meta-analysis of jujube effects on metabolic syndrome
- [Dosage exploration of the effects of honey and its derivatives on cardiometabolic outcomes: an overview of systematic reviews and GRADE-assessed updated meta-analysis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00403-9): Umbrella review of honey, royal jelly & propolis cardiometabolic effects

## Diabetes Treatment and Drug Mechanisms

- [Revealing the role of increased SK3 expression in sulfonylurea resistance triggered by prolonged exposure](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00384-9): SK3 channel overexpression in sulfonylurea resistance mechanisms in T2DM
- [A promising approach to diabetic osteoporosis: oxymatrine's effects on gut microbiota and osteoblasts](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00374-x): Oxymatrine study on diabetic osteoporosis via gut microbiota & miR-539-5p
- [Effectiveness of whole course fine nursing combined with insulin pump blood glucose management on patients with diabetes mellitus combined with ischemic cerebral infarction](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00376-9): Clinical trial on nursing plus insulin pump for DM with ischemic stroke

## Optional

- [Correction: Trends in Children's Dietary Inflammatory Index and association with prediabetes in U.S. adolescents](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41387-025-00393-8): Author correction for Children's Dietary Inflammatory Index article
